title: fix(rangeSlider): fixed tooltip CSS & outdated default theme.
body:
The `default-theme.css` is not required anymore since we load the `instantsearch.css` (cc @pixelastic).

Fix #527

comments.body:
Hmm, I think we still need the `width: 100%` on the search box.

ie. we still need some specific styling of the widget for the documentation that are not part of the `instantsearch.css` file, and I feel we should keep them in a separate file than the rest of the CSS for the docs
